gates.targetIdentity: real supabase-hosted throwaway smoke project · postgres 17 · ref-fingerprint 90815847e84b600a
gates.proves: real hosted Supabase project: Data + Auth + RLS end to end, opt-in/budget refusals, deterministic cleanup + crash recovery
gates.limitations: Requires the dedicated throwaway smoke project's credentials (SUPADIFF_HOSTED_ACCESS_TOKEN, SUPADIFF_HOSTED_PROJECT_REF). Fail-closed: with SUPADIFF_HOSTED=1 and no credentials the command exits non-zero rather than skipping. Cleanup proves the measured owned-resource census returns to the pre-run empty state, not a byte-for-byte project image. `create-ephemeral` and `--target hosted` upgrades are not exercised. Runs entirely over the live hosted API/Management API, so a transient upstream fault during runtime capability probing can finalize a single attempt `unsupported` (infrastructure outcome, not a behavioral result); the recorded result is from an attempt that completed cleanly.
notes: 1 test(s) reported skipped by vitest — the fail-closed credential-precondition block (inert when hosted credentials are present); all 13 real hosted tests ran
